faq.question: RTX 4060 vs RTX 4060 Ti for running LLMs?
faq.answer: The RTX 4060 Ti 16GB is the better AI card: double the VRAM lets it run 14B models the base 4060 cannot. The 4060 is fine for 7B models, but if local AI is your goal, the 16GB 4060 Ti is worth the extra cost.

faq.question: How much VRAM does the Tesla T4 have?
faq.answer: The Tesla T4 has 16GB of GDDR6 at 300 GB/s (NVIDIA datasheet). ModelFit budgets about 14.4GB of it for weights and context, enough for dense models up to 14B at Q4 quantization.

faq.question: Does Ollama support the Tesla T4?
faq.answer: Yes. Ollama lists the T4 under compute capability 7.5 in its NVIDIA support table and needs driver version 550 or newer. It runs the card through CUDA with no extra setup.

faq.question: What size LLM can I run on a Tesla T4?
faq.answer: Dense models up to 14B at Q4, such as Qwen3 14B (~11GB) at est. 22 tok/s, typical error 15%, plus 20B-class mixture-of-experts models. 8B models run at est. 37 tok/s, typical error 5%. Dense 27B and 32B models spill into system RAM.

faq.question: Tesla T4 vs RTX 3060 for local AI?
faq.answer: The T4 has 16GB against 12GB, so it holds 14B models with longer contexts and 20B-class mixture-of-experts models the 3060 cannot. The RTX 3060 streams more memory (360 vs 300 GB/s), so it is faster on models both fit (est. 50 tok/s, typical error 5% vs est. 37 tok/s on 8B). The T4 is passively cooled (NVIDIA datasheet) and needs server airflow.

faq.question: How fast is a 27B-class model on the Tesla T4?
faq.answer: The Tesla T4's 16GB of VRAM cannot fit a 32B model comfortably. The largest size class it fits is 20B MoE (3.6B active), at est. 50 tok/s, typical error 15%. The largest individual model in the catalog that fits is LFM2 24B-A2B Instruct (24B).
